comment: All candidates shared a very small Adagrad displacement (approximately 0.0064), so architecture rather than optimizer progress decided the ranking. K1006 supported prioritizing normalization: C had four LayerNorms, D three, E and A two, and B none. K1008 supported the normalized rectifier candidates over GELU, without treating activation as sufficient to rescue unnormalized B. E versus A was less certain: E’s terminal normalization and plain architecture favored it over A’s residual network with an unnormalized tail. K1076 was only contextual evidence, not a directly matched rule. This result supports the existing scoped preferences but adds no tested general rule.
